scope: SDevice-only shared-node Si/SiO2 region-resolved finite-volume assembly diagnostic
claim_policy: The diagnostic retains one shared electrostatic degree of freedom at each material-interface node.
The three factors change only region-local geometric weighting; default assembly remains unchanged.
Local coefficient ratios are not terminal-current error multipliers.
A better current match supports an interface-assembly contribution but does not prove equivalence to Sentaurus double-point internals.
